technical.summary: ABBV shows long-term bullish structure with MACD crossover and price above 200-MA, but overbought oscillators and weak intermediate trend (20/50 EMA) combined with neutral sector momentum limit swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: ABBV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 23 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and recent with minimal conviction; no news data to confirm thesis.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX in crisis territory (354.6), flat yield curve signalling recession risk, rising dollar pressuring multinationals, NFP event in 2 days, and earnings in 23 days create compounded uncertainty.

debate.key_bull_argument: MACD bullish crossover with price above 200-MA provides long-term structural support, and extreme market fear (28/100) creates contrarian opportunity for mean reversion into earnings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Overbought oscillators (Stoch, Williams %R, StochRSI), weak intermediate trend (20/50 EMA bearish), macro crisis (VIX 354.6, flat yield curve, strong dollar), NFP in 2 days, and earnings in 23 days create compounded risk that overwhelms technical setup.
